subject: [RFC PATCH 22/57] mm/collapse: walk a table with a selection cursor

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new feature to walk a table with a selection cursor, which is used to select candidate windows from the table. The cursor advances at emission and never rewinds, and it assumes that every attempt will succeed within a round. The patch also keeps track of non-present PTEs accepted by the scan in cc->scan_unmapped, adding them back only for PMD candidates. The selection process is bounded by huge page alignment and the largest enabled order.
